question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I won the online game of chess ________ I was out of practice.
solution:
The correct answer is: **even though**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given words.
 
 
• '**Because**' is used for showing the reason something happens or the reason why it is described in a particular way.

 
 
• **Example -** *I ate a lot because I was hungry.*
 
 
 
• '**Even though**' means despite the fact that. It comes before a statement of fact.
 
 
• **Example -** *She stayed with him even though he often mistreated her.*
 
 
 
• '**Even if**' means whether or not and has to do with the conditions that may apply.
 
 
• **Example -** *Even if I had two hours to spare shopping, I wouldn't go out and buy a suit.*
 
 
 
• '**Unless**' means if not. We use it in conditional sentences instead of if not.
 
 
• **Example -** *You will feel cold unless you wear a warm jacket.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​​*According to the use of the given words, we can say **'even though'** is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **Despite my lack of preparation, I succeeded in the chess game played online.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *I won the online game of chess **even though**__ I was out of practice.*
